# Shui Song Luar

> AI & Systems Engineer at NUSX Labs building production LLM systems and agents, LLM evals, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. Previously Founding Engineer at SoraNova. Based in Singapore.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention to help large language models efficiently discover the most relevant information on this site.

## About

- [About](https://luarss.dev/about/): Background, experience, education, and skills. AI & Systems Engineer at NUSX Labs; previously Founding Engineer at SoraNova, AI Engineer at Espressif Systems, and Graduate Research Assistant at NUS (IROS 2021 Best Paper Award).

## Projects & Publications

- [Projects index](https://luarss.dev/projects/): Open source projects, publications, and writing.
- [nova-agent-runtime](https://github.com/SoraNovaAI/agent-runtime): AI agent framework with integrated tools, multi-agent workflows, evaluation loops, native MCP integration, and YAML-based declarative configuration.
- [OpenROAD-MCP](https://github.com/The-OpenROAD-Project/OpenROAD-MCP): MCP server enabling real-time AI-driven debugging for chip designers in OpenROAD. Began as a side project of Shui Song Luar's and now lives under the OpenROAD Project; a Google Summer of Code 2026 student worked on it under Shui Song's mentorship.
- [ORAssistant](https://github.com/luarss/ORAssistant): Production-ready LLM chatbot assistant for the OpenROAD chip design tool.

## Publications

- [ORAssistant: A Custom RAG-based Conversational Assistant for OpenROAD](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2410.03845) (WOSET 2024): RAG-based conversational assistant for chip design automation.
- [Extended Tactile Perception: Vibration Sensing through Tools and Grasped Objects](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2106.00489) (IROS 2021, Best Paper Award): ML classification on high-dimensional time-series tactile sensor data.

## Writing

- [Supply Chain Hygiene for Claude Code Plugins](https://luarss.dev/posts/supply-chain-hygiene-claude-plugins/) (Oct 2026): Pinning Claude Code plugins, GitHub Actions, and zsh plugins to verified commit SHAs, with automated update checks.
- [OpenROAD MCP: Let AI Close Your Timing](https://luarss.dev/posts/openroad-mcp-let-ai-close-your-timing/) (Feb 2026): Server enabling AI assistants to drive OpenROAD for timing analysis and constraint adjustment.
- [Building Robust AI Research Agents: A tale of five specialists](https://luarss.dev/posts/building-robust-ai-research-agents/) (Nov 2025): Four architectural iterations of a deep research workflow for VCs.
- [Multi-Agent Systems Are 23x Cheaper Than Deep Research Models with Higher Quality](https://luarss.dev/posts/multi-agent-systems-23x-cheaper/) (Nov 2025): Benchmarking 11 specialised agents against single-model and deep reasoning models across 5 scientific domains.

## Usage policy

This site's [robots.txt](https://luarss.dev/robots.txt) declares Content Signals: `search=yes, ai-train=no, ai-input=yes`. Content may be used for search indexing and as real-time AI input (e.g., grounding), but not for training generative AI models.
